verdict: EXACT CORRECTIONS REQUIRED: one issue EX58-X01. Scoped authored-candidate acceptance authorized conditionally on the named exact amendment and finite checks. No new source conference.

sourceDirections.title: One authority map
sourceDirections.assessment: KEEP the explicit precedence map and preservation of older source versions. No fulfilled domain is reopened by an old preparation label.

sourceDirections.title: Roster, offices and real teams
sourceDirections.assessment: KEEP the twelve-character cap, real actors and five actual offices. EX58-EDIT-01 is correctly represented; offices neither confer proficiency nor multiply time.

sourceDirections.title: One elapsed campaign clock and Watch accounting
sourceDirections.assessment: KEEP one elapsed clock, half-open intervals, compatible parallel labor, two productive Watches, prospective Rest Debt, exact interruption and benefit lockouts.

sourceDirections.title: Supply is coverage of real obligations
sourceDirections.assessment: KEEP Supply as actual food/water/fuel/sundry coverage, with source-specific needs and no automatic fuel consumption or abstract replacement inventory.

sourceDirections.title: Procurement, storage and finite magical support
sourceDirections.assessment: KEEP finite procurement, actual containers/tare/capacity and separate nutrition, light and magical permissions. Stocks and preparation do not reset origin or age.

sourceDirections.title: Forage, pooled Sustenance and depletion
sourceDirections.assessment: KEEP predeclared finite forage/Sustenance allocations, actual work and nonoverlapping reserve output. A successful forage does not create oil or duplicate prior material.

sourceDirections.title: Finite camps and independent safety
sourceDirections.assessment: KEEP the authored camp bodies, mark totals, costs, actor labor and storage limits; building a camp does not automatically establish safety or heal gear.

sourceDirections.title: Pressure event ledger
sourceDirections.assessment: KEEP cause-bound Pressure, current cohort history, cargo high-water accounting and bounded real reductions. Do not charge the same disclosure or Watch cause twice.

sourceDirections.title: Total d6 severity and bounded complication processing
sourceDirections.assessment: KEEP the full modified-d6 severity rule, Pressure0/6 endpoints, equal-result qualification and once-per-root secondary processing with actual time/consequences.

sourceDirections.title: Route progress and mapping
sourceDirections.assessment: KEEP route quality, Mapping, access and convoy pace as separate inputs. Progress does not also award free mileage, time or travel through a blocked route.

sourceDirections.title: Forced march and travel interruption
sourceDirections.assessment: KEEP actual forced-travel intervals, declared extra supplies and source-specific interruption; no forced-march roll erases travel, debt or physical limits.

sourceDirections.title: Extraction episode and cargo admission
sourceDirections.assessment: KEEP exact cargo identities, classification, priority, actual burden and extraction-episode reservation. Class is not pounds, and pricing creates no cargo.

sourceDirections.title: Finite extraction checkpoints
sourceDirections.assessment: KEEP route-specific checkpoint cadence and coalesced coincident triggers; actual one-minute checks and partial exposed Watch settlement occur once.

sourceDirections.title: Failure choices, elapsed delays and cargo response
sourceDirections.assessment: KEEP the declared alternative failure consequences, eight-hour delays, real risk-response work and bounded threats. A risk record is not automatic loss or death.

sourceDirections.title: Retreat: one bounded chase round
sourceDirections.assessment: KEEP the source-native retreat check, own actor budgets, one paid threat per chase round and three-before-three termination; a 3/3 tie is not escape.

sourceDirections.title: Encounter estimate and actual participants
sourceDirections.assessment: KEEP participant-based N_eff and encounter estimates distinct from roster and physical carriers. Calibration numbers do not establish observed balance.

sourceDirections.title: Transport and inventory integration
sourceDirections.assessment: KEEP cargo/support/handling and custody constraints shared with transport; do not replace actual pounds, geometry or provider work with a Load label.

sourceDirections.title: Integrity retained as history, structural HP operative
sourceDirections.assessment: KEEP operative structural HP and retained legacy Integrity. An existing HP record is not healed by reinterpreting an older Integrity value.

sourceDirections.title: Haven intake, evidence and disposition
sourceDirections.assessment: KEEP actual Haven actors, intake, inspections, provenance, custody and scheduled service intervals. Authority and completed work are not inferred from a title.

sourceDirections.title: Valuation has one correct domain
sourceDirections.assessment: KEEP separate equipment, crafted-item, material and artifact valuation domains; real finite buyers and missing artifact inputs stay explicit.

sourceDirections.title: One gross-to-net ledger and one rounding per transaction
sourceDirections.assessment: KEEP one gross-to-net ledger and final-transaction rounding. Already paid mandatory costs appear once; negative estimates do not invent credit or debt.

sourceDirections.title: Claims, sponsors, taxes and finite insurance
sourceDirections.assessment: KEEP distinct sponsor/policy sources, actual taxable brackets, cumulative partial claims and one deductible per loss episode. No duplicate payout.

sourceDirections.title: One standing policy, preserved originals
sourceDirections.assessment: KEEP one operational standing policy, signed scene accounting and lossless raw/source-version records. Do not turn the refinements into independent scales.

sourceDirections.title: Haven work, services, instruction and recovery
sourceDirections.assessment: KEEP each service, learning, research, Scribing and condition-care procedure's actual hours, prerequisites and costs. Haven entry is not completion.

sourceDirections.title: Coin, crime, labor and rescue preserve real status
sourceDirections.assessment: KEEP the EX58-EDIT-02 greater-of liability and fee allocation, innocent/unproven-intent boundaries and actual lawful assessment. Preserve person/status distinctions.

sourceDirections.title: Advancement, closure and a real next descent
sourceDirections.assessment: KEEP declared advancement, prior resource state, real closure and distinct next-descent purchases. No pending choice or resource refill is awarded by bookkeeping.

sourceDirections.title: Want, leverage, authority and one declared uncertainty
sourceDirections.assessment: KEEP actual Want/Leverage/Limit, authority and declared possible uncertainty. Automatic cooperation and impossible requests do not receive fabricated checks.

sourceDirections.title: Four degrees, three narrative possibilities
sourceDirections.assessment: KEEP announced Success and native Core/opposed distinctions. A costly agreement after Failure is a separate freely accepted offer, not a hidden Success surcharge.

sourceDirections.title: All five Charisma skills and actual Insight
sourceDirections.assessment: KEEP the five actual Charisma skill scopes and evidence-limited Insight. No social skill grants telepathy, ownership, lawmaking or guaranteed obedience.

sourceDirections.title: Standing access is not an added die modifier
sourceDirections.assessment: KEEP standing-based access without importing a second universal numerical modifier from the competing historical scale.

sourceDirections.title: Alignment remains receipt-only
sourceDirections.assessment: KEEP alignment text as preserved, nonoperative receipts in this scope. No moral, cosmological or alignment auto-bonus is inferred.

sourceDirections.title: One communication clock for all participants
sourceDirections.assessment: KEEP the LAX communication clock, aggregate short speech, real interpretation and named components. More speakers do not create simultaneous translated time.

sourceDirections.title: Actual Help and meaningful retries
sourceDirections.assessment: KEEP actual Help intervals/expiration and meaningful changed-evidence retries. Ally rotation, repeated unchanged requests and token assistance grant nothing.

sourceDirections.title: Magic and acquired class interfaces do only their own work
sourceDirections.assessment: KEEP each selected class/oath/spell effect's actual trigger, cost, perception, command and expiry. Shared names and comparisons do not promote pending options.

sourceDirections.title: Agreements do not manufacture authority or player consent
sourceDirections.assessment: KEEP actual authority, agreements and table consent; checks and fictional compulsion do not override player safety or convey another person's property.

sourceDirections.title: Witnessed attributed consequences and standing
sourceDirections.assessment: KEEP witnessed, attributed institution-specific consequences and one signed scene-opening delta. No unseen report or repeated proof becomes a fresh award.

sourceDirections.title: Faction turns are paid actions, not return rewards
sourceDirections.assessment: KEEP global 24-hour and genuine-return coalescing, at most three watched factions, actual independent workers, action times and received information.

sourceDirections.title: Finite rival clocks and complete faction records
sourceDirections.assessment: KEEP finite predeclared rival clocks, real causes and blocked thresholds. Reaching a threshold is not permission for an impossible raid, route or instant report.

sourceDirections.title: Nine real mount profiles
sourceDirections.assessment: KEEP all nine source-bound mount rows and explicitly NEW complete physical profiles. Source price/speed/carry remains distinct from added body values.

sourceDirections.title: Riding control, training and actor caps
sourceDirections.assessment: KEEP real willingness/training/control, actor caps and completed handling work. A mount's presence grants no extra independent class/device command budget.

sourceDirections.title: One whole regular turn for a controlled mount
sourceDirections.decision: KEEP operative direction; EX58-X01 example correction
sourceDirections.assessment: KEEP the whole controlled-mount turn after its rider, permitted actions and prospective scheduling. EX-W13's separate RP fixture requires EX58-X01.

sourceDirections.title: Mount, dismount and stay seated
sourceDirections.decision: KEEP operative direction; EX58-X01 example correction
sourceDirections.assessment: KEEP current-Speed dismount cost, actual hands/support and one source-defined seat check per physical root. EX58-X01 corrects only EX-W13's RP premises.

sourceDirections.title: Mounted geometry and opportunity attacks
sourceDirections.decision: KEEP operative direction; EX58-X01 example correction
sourceDirections.assessment: KEEP actual mounted seat/reach geometry and one lawful opportunity-attack budget. EX58-X01 does not change EX-W13's seat or movement result.

sourceDirections.title: Pending mounted feats and motion hooks
sourceDirections.decision: KEEP operative direction; EX58-X01 example correction
sourceDirections.assessment: KEEP actual self-powered Dragoon movement, no carried/teleport credit, narrow Dissonance—not RP—reduction and pending feat boundaries. Correct EX-W13 pools by EX58-X01.

sourceDirections.title: All tack, feed and boarding rows
sourceDirections.assessment: KEEP all tack, feed and boarding source rows, exact fit/capacity, separate feed/water and real stable care. Barding costs/mass and armor candidate are not compounded twice.

sourceDirections.title: Five drawn vehicles and distinct Dungeon sled
sourceDirections.assessment: KEEP the five drawn vehicles, actual driver/puller contributions and physical capacities; Player Sled and Core Dungeon sled remain different records.

sourceDirections.title: All six watercraft, real crews and movement
sourceDirections.assessment: KEEP all six watercraft, real crew/propulsion/wind/draft/body limits and paid work. No native vehicle turn, automatic crew or capacity-based expedition-cap waiver.

sourceDirections.title: Porter, bearer and pack-animal services
sourceDirections.assessment: KEEP porter, bearer and animal service rates, real load/handling and work/rest limits. Hiring does not create bodies, ownership or extra combat participants.

sourceDirections.title: Hauler, caravans and specialist extraction
sourceDirections.assessment: KEEP the manually controlled finite Hauler, moving-time fuel and service counters. Caravan/teleport quotations remain distinct from actual travel or spell permission.

sourceDirections.title: Passengers, casualties and exact transfer work
sourceDirections.assessment: KEEP real passenger/casualty mass, stretcher capacity, actual transfers and compatible helpers. Petrification does not multiply gear or invent a carry allowance.

sourceDirections.title: One route travel rate and real transfers
sourceDirections.assessment: KEEP one convoy pace, real route modifiers, transfers and actual travel time. Do not double-apply route penalties or gain mileage from reassigned Progress.

sourceDirections.title: Living recovery, structural repair and rescue
sourceDirections.assessment: KEEP living healing separate from structural repair, original-member requirements, actual material/time and finite sinking/shoring/towing. Repair does not reset service, custody or terminal claims.

sourceDirections.title: Explicit source-version interpretation, not clamping
sourceDirections.assessment: KEEP explicit known-version interpretations with preserved raw values. Unknown versions are not automatically clamped into the adopted scale.

sourceDirections.title: Lossless raw envelopes and unknown keys
sourceDirections.assessment: KEEP byte-preserving envelopes, ordered duplicate keys, null/absence/zero/false/strings and parse failures. No real saves were read or migrated.

sourceDirections.title: All20 background starts and actual later histories
sourceDirections.assessment: KEEP all twenty background starts and the Cult Escapee authorities Disliked=-1 correction. Replace only a provably wrong initialization contribution, then replay earned history.

sourceDirections.title: Display labels never rewrite numeric authority
sourceDirections.assessment: KEEP display labels as derived views; ambiguous historical labels cannot rewrite exact scores or recreate absent keys.

sourceDirections.title: 44 stable institution keys and privacy
sourceDirections.assessment: KEEP all forty-four stable source institution identities without treating the registry as a closed-world whitelist. Public names do not publish private dossiers.

sourceDirections.title: Signed events, caps and reversible interpretation
sourceDirections.assessment: KEEP signed scene proposals from the opening score, one ±2 scene cap, ±3 scale cap, retained overflow and reversible source interpretation; no sequential-clamp exploit.

boundaryCases.title: Rest debt without another refill

boundaryCases.title: Provision quantities, daylight and different recipients

boundaryCases.evidenceClass: Director semantic adjudication of an authored synthetic example; not runtime or campaign authentication

boundaryCases.title: One finite forage site

boundaryCases.title: Camp marks, installed stock and replacement storage

boundaryCases.evidenceClass: Director semantic adjudication of an authored synthetic example; not runtime or campaign authentication

boundaryCases.title: Pressure equality, natural results and unchanged exposure

boundaryCases.title: Finite extraction checkpoints and a Severe root

boundaryCases.evidenceClass: Director semantic adjudication of an authored synthetic example; not runtime or campaign authentication

boundaryCases.title: A route’s time multiplier is applied once
boundaryCases.assessment: Route quality and Strain speed effects act once on actual moving time; independent delays are not converted into mileage.
boundaryCases.evidenceClass: Director semantic adjudication of an authored synthetic example; not runtime or campaign authentication

boundaryCases.title: Forced-march stock and extraction high-water marks

boundaryCases.title: Extraction modifiers and a real choice after failure

boundaryCases.evidenceClass: Director semantic adjudication of an authored synthetic example; not runtime or campaign authentication

boundaryCases.title: Actual encounter contributors and retreat comparison
boundaryCases.assessment: Anacite actual cost/command/attack and N_eff remain source-scoped; 3/3 retreat is failure.

boundaryCases.title: Whole mounted turns and prospective transfer

boundaryCases.title: Carried movement is not Dragoon self-motion
boundaryCases.assessment: EX58-X01 corrects Mage3 RP10→7 to8→5 and Dragoon8 RP10→8 to7→5. Movement, prices, Dissonance and source effects are unchanged.

boundaryCases.title: Separate draw, back-load and vehicle limits
boundaryCases.assessment: Gross draw/payload, barding and the two different sled profiles are not conflated or double-priced.
boundaryCases.evidenceClass: Director semantic adjudication of an authored synthetic example; not runtime or campaign authentication

boundaryCases.title: A rowboat carries its people too
boundaryCases.assessment: Rowboat crew, payload and draft are finite; a fifth/overweight addition has no capacity exception.
boundaryCases.evidenceClass: Director semantic adjudication of an authored synthetic example; not runtime or campaign authentication

boundaryCases.title: Shoring a sinking hull does not repair it
boundaryCases.assessment: Shoring and towing preserve the original sinking deadline/disabled state; body repair is not a second service fee.

boundaryCases.title: Paid transport services have real limits
